request.subject: PORTRAIT:GUARD

layers.text: Change only his shield and armour: the shield becomes a bigger rectangular tower shield with a flat top, as wide as his body, covering him from his chin to the bottom of the image, crimson with a gold cross and a thick steel border; he wears polished steel plate with one big round steel pauldron on his shoulder. Do not redraw anything else: keep the kettle helmet with its gold band, the face, the upright spear, proportions, outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
